Off-white, graphite, natural wood, muted steel blue with a tiny burnt-orange accent. Soft directional daylight, realistic optics, strong composition, foreground/background depth. The story must be understandable as a thumbnail. ONE clear narrative, a carefully edited 3–5 meaningful elements, breathing space, not an empty generic laptop stock photo, not a cluttered desk. Small-business and independent creator scale, not metropolitan corporate luxury. Human hands or a partial shoulder may appear naturally, never a prominent face. A discreet thin translucent line or frosted-glass connector may explain how input becomes output, but never random decorative geometry. Screens and printed artifacts must show recognizable purposeful visual layouts; avoid large text, readable paragraphs, brand names and logos. No robots, mascots, floating neon hologram clutter, flowers, cozy feminine accessories, piles of gadgets, city skyline, classroom, or lecture scene. Professionally composed high-end photographic campaign art, not an infographic, not an anime illustration. Every physical and visual element must serve this specific story: RAG: answer a question from permitted reference material and show the source. A beautifully composed real open reference binder on a desk, containing a clean community-event FAQ layout. One specific paragraph strip is highlighted pale blue. Next to it a tablet displays a short answer card, a tiny source-document thumbnail underneath, with one single precise translucent connector leading back to the HIGHLIGHTED source strip. A second closed charcoal folder with a small discrete privacy symbol stays outside the connector, showing material not included. No glowing database globes. Focus on traceable evidence, not documents scattered everywhere.

images.name: lesson-climbing

images.scene: This is an AI-assisted educational material production example, NOT a climbing equipment advertisement. One small authentic climbing hold at the far edge establishes the topic, secondary. Clear transformation from knowledge to shareable teaching materials, natural stone-blue palette.

images.name: lesson-coding
images.alt: 見積もり計算ツールの設計案、コード、動作結果を比べるコーディング実践のイメージ
images.scene: Programming practice learning material: a small web tool becomes reliable through a visible edit and check. A realistic close-up development laptop viewed from the side, showing an abstract two-column code revision at left and a tiny working quotation calculator preview at right with simple numeric blocks. In the foreground, a one-page wireframe of the SAME calculator has two checkmarks and one orange correction circle; a hand aligns the paper with the screen. An understated thin blue annotation links the corrected field. The emphasis is reading, testing and understanding a small change, no hacker imagery.
